title.en: Chapter 1 — The King Who Would Not Say His Name
title.ar: الفصل 1 — الملك اللي ما بده يقول اسمه

book_meta.author: Arthur Conan Doyle
book_meta.status: public domain — all Holmes entered the US public domain by 2023

sentences.en: To Sherlock Holmes, she was always the woman.
He never mentioned her name.

sentences.ar: كان يقول "المرا"، وكل واحد بيعرف مين قصده.
sentences.en: He said the woman, and everyone knew whom he meant.

sentences.ar: أنا الدكتور واطسون، وهاي قصة الليلة اللي خسر فيها هولمز.
sentences.en: I am Doctor Watson, and this is the story of the night Holmes lost.

sentences.ar: كنت تزوجت من كم شهر، وتركت شارع بيكر، وصار لي وقت ما شفته.
sentences.en: I had married a few months before, left Baker Street, and had not seen him for a while.

sentences.ar: وبليلة، وأنا راجع من مريض، مرقت من قدام بيته، وشفت ظله عالشباك.
sentences.en: And one night, coming back from a patient, I passed his house, and saw his shadow on the window.

sentences.ar: طويل، ونحيف، وإيديه ورا ظهره، وبيمشي رايح جاي.
sentences.en: Tall, thin, hands behind his back, pacing back and forth.
So there was a case.
So I went up.

sentences.ar: قال هولمز، بلا ما يلف: تزوجت، يا واطسون.
sentences.en: Holmes said, without turning: you have married, Watson.
And gained seven kilos.
And gone back to practising.

sentences.ar: وخادمتك مش شاطرة، وكنت بالمطر مبارح.
sentences.en: And your maid is careless, and you were out in the rain yesterday.
I said: Holmes, how did you know?
He said: your boots.

sentences.ar: فيها ست خدوش على الجنب، من واحدة بتنضف بلا اهتمام.
sentences.en: Six scratches on the side, from someone cleaning them carelessly.
And the mud on them from yesterday.

sentences.ar: وريحة اليود على إصبعك، وعلامة السماعة بجيبك.
sentences.en: And the smell of iodine on your finger, and the mark of the stethoscope in your pocket.

sentences.ar: قلت: لما بتشرح، بتصير الشغلة سهلة لدرجة إني بحس إني كنت بقدر أعملها.
sentences.en: I said: when you explain, it becomes so simple I feel I could have done it myself.
He said: exactly.
And there is the difference.
You see, but you do not observe.
How many steps on the stairs you just climbed?
I said: I do not know.
He said: seventeen.
Because I observe.

sentences.ar: وأعطاني ورقة، وقال: هاي وصلت اليوم.
sentences.en: And he handed me a paper, and said: this came today.
Read it.

sentences.ar: ورقة سميكة وغالية، بلا اسم، بلا تاريخ.
sentences.en: Thick, expensive paper, no name, no date.

sentences.ar: مكتوب فيها: رح يزورك الليلة الساعة تمانية سيد، بمسألة بالغة الأهمية.
sentences.en: It said: a gentleman will call on you tonight at eight, on a matter of the utmost importance.

sentences.ar: وخدماتك الأخيرة لبيت ملكي بأوروبا بتبين إنك أهل للثقة.
sentences.en: And your recent services to a royal house in Europe show you can be trusted.
And he will come masked.
I said: what do you make of it?
He said: the paper is German, from Bohemia.

sentences.ar: والجملة مبنية زي ما بيبنيها الألمان.
sentences.en: And the sentence is built the way Germans build one.

sentences.ar: وواحد بيكتب "بالغة الأهمية" وبيجي بقناع، مش خايف من الناس.
sentences.en: And a man who writes utmost importance and comes masked is not afraid of people.
He is afraid of himself.

sentences.ar: وبنفس اللحظة، سمعنا عربية بتوقف تحت، وصوت خيل.
sentences.en: And in that same moment, we heard a carriage stop below, and the sound of horses.
Holmes said: two horses.
So very rich.

sentences.ar: وبتلبس القناع الآن، ولا بعد ما يطلع؟
sentences.en: And is the mask on now, or after he comes up?

sentences.ar: دخل رجل طوله زي الباب، وعرضه زي الباب كمان.
sentences.en: A man came in as tall as the door, and as wide as the door too.

sentences.ar: لابس فرو، وجزمة عالية، وعلى وجهه قناع أسود بيغطي عينيه.
sentences.en: Dressed in fur, high boots, and on his face a black mask covering his eyes.

sentences.ar: قال بلهجة ألمانية تقيلة: أنا الكونت فون كرام.
sentences.en: He said in a heavy German accent: I am Count von Kramm.
And I want to speak with you alone.

sentences.ar: قمت أطلع، بس هولمز مسكني من كمي، وقال: الدكتور صاحبي، وبيسمع كل شي.
sentences.en: I got up to leave, but Holmes caught my sleeve, and said: the doctor is my friend, and hears everything.
The count hesitated, and then sat.

sentences.ar: قال: القضية بتخص بيت ملكي كبير، وإذا انكشفت، بتهز أوروبا.
sentences.en: He said: the matter concerns a great royal house, and if it comes out, it will shake Europe.
Holmes said: I know.
The house of Ormstein, kings of Bohemia.
Please go on, Your Majesty.

sentences.ar: الرجل نط من كرسيه، ومشى بالغرفة، وبعدين شلح القناع، ورماه عالأرض.
sentences.en: The man leapt from his chair, paced the room, and then tore off the mask, and threw it on the floor.
He said: correct.
I am the king.
Why hide?
Holmes said: indeed, why?
And now, what is the problem?
